name: git_compose_apply
description: Create commits from a plan you authored over the hunks listed by git_compose_collect. Every collected hunk must appear in exactly one commit; commits are created in the order given. Show the user the plan before applying unless they already asked for these commits. Fails with stale_collection (nothing modified) if the changes were edited since collecting. Use dry_run to validate the plan and see the commit/file layout without changing anything. The result carries an undo_id. Commits are signed when the repository sets commit.gpgsign; a signing failure returns signing_failed with nothing modified. Fails with timed_out if the apply runs past its time limit; follow the message to check the repository before retrying.

commits.description: Commits to create, in order (dependencies first)

dry_run.description: Validate and return the layout without creating commits
